prs.title: fix: don't throw on import when window.screen.orientation is unavailable
prs.author: reidbarber
prs.body:
Closes https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/issues/10742

When `window.screen.orientation` doesn't exist (i.e. a jsdom env with `NODE_ENV` != `test`, or browsers without the Screen Orientation API), a `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'angle')` error is thrown when `setupGlobalEvents()` is called (on package import).

Updated this to fall back to an angle of `0` when it's missing, and makes the jsdom shim also cover `screen.orientation` being `undefined`.
